meta.parties: Board of Directiors of Savings Bank v. Nagodavitane

rules.statement: A defendant in a hypothecary action who absents himself on the date on which he is due to file answer is not entitled thereafter, without purging his default, to obtain relief under the proviso to section 48 (1) of the Mortgage Act.
rules.supporting_quote: "The court has no power to take a course of action other than, that prescribed in s. 85 of the Civil Procedure Code when the defendant fails to appear on the day fixed for the subsequent filing of his answer."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 48 (1) of the Mortgage Act (Cap. 89). Section 85 of the Civil Procedure Code.
